evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2020 (6 years old), 500 m NE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).

SE facing slope, 14 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Nordschow Creek 60 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).
